subject.title: fix: reject unsafe Mattermost API path segments

question: Should this security-boundary PR require controlled HTTP after-fix proof, or may the existing mocked transport coverage receive a proof override?
rationale: Repository policy requires real behavior proof for external non-docs PRs, but a maintainer may explicitly accept the focused source and mock evidence for this pre-fetch guard.

options.title: Require controlled HTTP proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output from a local HTTP listener showing a normal request succeeds and unsafe paths never reach the server with a bearer token.

options.title: Approve proof override
options.body: Accept the source-level boundary and focused mock coverage as sufficient for this narrowly deterministic pre-fetch validation.

recommendation.title: Require controlled HTTP proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output from a local HTTP listener showing a normal request succeeds and unsafe paths never reach the server with a bearer token.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to this PR and directly refined both the missing media boundary and final validation implementation.
